title: Gurdwara Sis Ganj Sahib
visualBrief: Whole Gurdwara Sis Ganj Sahib: photo-reconstructed warm sandstone mainhall, tiered cornices, recessed jali windows, central gold onion dome and four open gold-domed corner chhatris; white marble street gateway with genuine open arches and three visible roof chhatris, intrinsic terrace/six steps; actual native four-control five-level flat-roof eastern wing. Worship-area rectangle is identity context only, never extruded as the hall. Qualla-published Jais006 2011 own CC0 exterior; hidden plans, heights, rear facades and current changes bounded. Separate neighboring mosque excluded.
